title: Add the published T450 allocation and compare its root with the selected kappa
body:
## Summary
- The published order joins 37 replicas with 8 replicas and takes ten copies: `10 · (37 + 8) = 450`. The schedule is `450 · 9 = 4,050` calls and `4,050 · 408 = 1,652,400` roles.
- The profile `{1:9983580, 2:2940300, 3:936579, 4:413100, 5:87495, 8:32400, 48:172221}` has 14,565,675 children and rank mass 29,289,600.
- The conditional root `0.001730047552093344159584 − 10^(−46) − 10^(−70)` is greater than the T740 root `0.001730006549538841847005` and greater than the selected kappa. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
